name: ArtifactReadTool
description: Inspect a saved tool result through its senera://resource/<six-character-id> URI. By default, without paths return a bounded structure outline. Its fields/items expose source entries; descriptor paths are the actual source JSON Pointers. Select fields with a paths array; use view=structure to inspect a nested object without summarizing it, or omit view to read its content. An empty pointer selects the whole part; view=content without paths also selects the whole part. Missing fields are distinct from null. Oversized selected content is summarized, mechanically reduced, then truncated if necessary; representation and completeness are explicit. Reads never repeat the original tool action.

uri.description: Saved result URI, normally senera://resource/<six-character-id>. Historical Artifact references remain readable.

part.description: Read result content, original source, process streams or execution outcome. Outcome exposes /assessment/error for the exact failure message and diagnostics.

paths.description: Exact JSON Pointers within the selected part, for example /links/0/url. Empty string selects the whole part. Omit for a structure outline.

view.description: Structure inspects the selected subtrees without LLM summarization and is the default without paths. Content returns selected values, defaults when paths are provided, and selects the whole part when paths are omitted.

requests.description: Resource references and optional exact field selections.
